name: HydrodynamicsLawLBM
description:
Engine to simulate fluid flow (with the lattice Boltzmann method) with a coupling with the discrete element method.
 If you use this Engine, please cite and refer to F. Lominé et al. International Journal For Numerical and Analytical Method in Geomechanics, 2012, doi: 10.1002/nag.1109

attributes.name: defaultLbmInitMode
attributes.description: Switch between the two initialisation methods

attributes.name: dP
attributes.description: Pressure difference between input and output

attributes.name: Rho
attributes.description: Fluid density

attributes.name: Nu
attributes.description: Fluid kinematic viscosity

attributes.name: tau
attributes.description: Relaxation time

attributes.name: Nx
attributes.description: The number of grid division in x direction

attributes.name: IterMax
attributes.description: This variable can be used to do several LBM iterations during one DEM iteration.

attributes.name: IterPrint
attributes.description: Print info on screen every IterPrint iterations

attributes.name: SaveMode
attributes.description: Save Mode (1-> default, 2-> in time (not yet implemented)

attributes.name: IterSave
attributes.description: Data are saved every IterSave LBM iteration (or see TimeSave)

attributes.name: TimeSave
attributes.description: Data are saved at constant time interval (or see IterSave)

attributes.name: SaveGridRatio
attributes.description: Grid data are saved every SaveGridRatio * IterSave LBM iteration (with SaveMode=1)

attributes.name: IterSubCyclingStart
attributes.description: Iteration number when the subcycling process starts

attributes.name: DemIterLbmIterRatio
attributes.description: Ratio between DEM and LBM iterations for subcycling

attributes.name: EngineIsActivated
attributes.description: To activate (or not) the engine

attributes.name: applyForcesAndTorques
attributes.description: Switch to apply forces and torques

attributes.name: ObservedNode
attributes.description: The identifier of the node that will be observed (-1 means none)

attributes.name: ObservedPtc
attributes.description: The identifier of the particle that will be observed (-1 means the first one)

attributes.name: RadFactor
attributes.description: The radius of DEM particules seen by the LBM is the real radius of particules*RadFactor

attributes.name: LBMSavedData
attributes.description: a list of data that will be saved. Can use velocity,velXY,forces,rho,bodies,nodeBD,newNode,observedptc,observednode,contacts,spheres,bz2

attributes.name: periodicity
attributes.description: periodicity

attributes.name: bc
attributes.description: Boundary condition

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: The LB model. Until now only d2q9 is implemented

attributes.name: removingCriterion
attributes.description: Criterion to remove a sphere (1->based on particle position, 2->based on particle velocity

attributes.name: VelocityThreshold
attributes.description: Velocity threshold when removingCriterion=2

attributes.name: EndTime
attributes.description: the time to stop the simulation

attributes.name: CstBodyForce
attributes.description: A constant body force (=that does not vary in time or space, otherwise the implementation introduces errors)

attributes.name: VbCutOff
attributes.description: the minimum boundary velocity that is taken into account

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.
